## Key Decisions
- **Review in the parent, no child agents**: user said "no scouts please" and asked for a quick review.
- **Top finding (high severity)**: `chooseSpanCut` validates candidates only against `getBranch()` but persists the chosen id to core. `index.ts:602` computes `contextEntry = resolved.some(e => e.id === cut.firstKeptEntryId)` and falls back to `branch` at `index.ts:606`, so the module *knows* the id is not context-visible and still sends it. Because `buildContextEntries` silently drops the whole pre-compaction tail on an unmatched id, a moved cut on a row invisible in the resolved view (reachable when timestamps and path order disagree — legacy/migrated or replayed sessions) loses the retained tail with no error signal. Suggested fix: abstain from moving unless the chosen id is context-visible.
- **Other findings to report**:
  - `chooseSpanCut` puts the `input.liveTokens === null` check inside the loop (reject, then `break`), so the loop runs once and the tally prints `1unmeasurable-live-context` as if a boundary had been considered; the final `reason` says "no earlier boundary admissible" for what is actually an abstention. AGENTS.md style prefers a guard clause.
  - Report tri-state `cutMoved=no|to:<id>|unrecorded` conflates abstain-because-blind with no-admissible-boundary; only `reason` separates them.
  - `tail = liveTokens - span` where `span` already includes `instructionTokens`; the instruction is not part of the live context, so it double-charges against `keepRecentTokens` → bias toward `tail-under-keep-budget` (conservative direction).
  - `CutDecision` has two JSDoc comments on one line (`reason: string; /** Retained history… */ tailTokens`), leaving `tailTokens`'s doc inline — artifact of a scripted edit.
  - `describe()` renders `3not-a-countable-boundary` with no separator.
  - Gate/walk interaction: when `skippedEntries !== 0`, `spanMessages` suppresses `keptEntry`, so the fit gate falls back to `getContextUsage()` (whole live context) and can skip stage 1 even though the walk moved the cut — yet `composeResult` persists `cut.firstKeptEntryId` on every route including `serialized`. Open question to raise: should a move persist when stage 1 abstained?

## Critical Context
- `7e87b9e` (+1274): `wireShaped()`/`estimateWireMessages()` stop charging stored-row bookkeeping (`details`, `usage`, `timestamp`, `responseId`) — a 13,289-token tail was priced at 26,294; `countSpanTokens` tiers `exact-cut` → `usage-anchor` → `none` plus `staleAnchors`; `countBoundary()` from newest `compaction`/`model_change`/`thinking_level_change` by timestamp; `anchoredRequestTokens` → `countedRequestTokens`; report `src=` states and 15%/50% skew bands; new `real-session-sizing.test.ts`; `RESUMPTION-POINTER.md`.
- `647f08b` (+766, tests + memory only): `cut-invariants.test.ts` (8 seeds + exhaustive 3^5) and `cut-shapes.test.ts` (catalogue located by role pair, never index). Findings: cut validity is about ids not roles; `[call][user][result]` leaves a surviving result citing an unseen call id; metadata rows at the cut are legal but never countable (branch-summary `usage`); the fuzz caught itself being vacuous (survived 3 of 4 mutations).
- `e9e906d` (+1067): new `cut.ts` (`chooseSpanCut`, `measureSpanAt`, `orphanedByPosition`); six conditions resolvable → countable → not expired → no orphaned tool call → `tail >= keepRecentTokens` → fits; core's id is a ceiling, earlier-only; `overflow` no longer skips stage 1 unconditionally; instruction hoisted into `StageContext` to break the size-before-cut cycle; `exact-anchor` estimateSource; `chosenFirstKeptEntryId`/`proposedFirstKeptEntryId` trace fields; `cut-selection.test.ts`; all seven mutations killed.
- Documented-open items: gap row 4 (children have no compaction UI), row 7 (`serializedMaxTokens: 12_000` / `maxChars: 48_000` silent shrink), no client-side deadline on summarization requests plus `maxRetries` asymmetry, `index.ts:758` stage-1 usage never persisted, missing `summaryBudget + keepRecentTokens + fixedPrefix < window - reserveTokens` post-condition, deferred later cut, deferred stored-count rescue.
- Budgets: `reserveTokens` 16,384 → `summaryBudget` 13,107, `segmentBudget` 4,369; `keepRecentTokens` 20,000.
- Validation commands: `npm run test:run`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run typecheck:tests`, `npx vitest run <file>`; suites `test/modules/compaction/{cut-shapes,cut-invariants,cut-selection,native-sizing,real-session-sizing,handler,trace}.test.ts`, `test/scripts/compaction-report.test.ts`.
- Relevant files: `src/modules/compaction/{index,native-request,cut,trace,types}.ts`, `scripts/compaction-report.ts`, `docs/compaction-trace-report.md`, `.pi/agent/memory/compaction.md`, `RESUMPTION-POINTER.md`.
